coverage: Whole group totals · single automobile segment · VECV included only as a share of profit
definition: Profit after tax that belongs to Eicher’s own shareholders. It includes Eicher’s share of profit from the VE Commercial Vehicles (VECV) truck-and-bus joint venture and is after a one-off Labour Codes charge. No profit belongs to outside shareholders in this year. It is not operating profit or cash.
sourceLabel: Statement of consolidated audited financial results, year ended 31 March 2026
location: PDF page 1 · statement of consolidated audited financial results, year ended 31.03.2026 column, rows 1–11 and profit attributable to owners; PDF page 4 · notes on Labour Codes and segment
notes: Revenue is revenue from operations (mostly Royal Enfield motorcycles, spare parts and riding gear) and excludes ₹1,486.53 crore other income, largely from investments. VECV’s own sales are not in revenue; Eicher adds only its ₹797.81 crore share of VECV’s profit. Profit is after a one-off ₹55.45 crore provision for the new Labour Codes. The group reports a single segment, automobile products, so no profit is split by brand or model.
insight: Revenue grew about 24% and owners’ profit about 16% compared with the previous year. About one-seventh of profit is Eicher’s share of the VECV truck-and-bus business rather than motorcycle sales.
